_note: Pre-registered before any variant result existed (2026-10-19 ~23:30). Changing a margin after seeing results needs a dated note in docs/DESIGN.md.

rules.kld_mean: 90% CI upper bound of mean KLD(variant) / mean KLD(accepted build) <= 1.10, per corpus part
rules.kld_p999: 90% CI upper bound of P99.9 KLD ratio vs the accepted build <= 1.10
rules.top1_agree: 90% CI lower bound of (agreement(variant) - agreement(accepted)) >= -0.5 points
rules.router_overlap: 90% CI lower bound of (top-10 overlap(variant) - overlap(accepted)) >= -0.5 points
rules.kld_long: documents, positions >= 16K: 90% CI upper bound of the KLD ratio vs the accepted build <= 1.10
rules.mc_accuracy: TOST: 90% CI of the paired accuracy delta vs the reference inside +-2 points (pooled MMLU-Pro + GPQA)
rules.mc_flips: 90% CI upper bound of (flip rate(variant) - flip rate(accepted)) <= +0.5 points; flip = argmax letter differs from the reference
rules.decode: IFEval strict prompt-level and HumanEval+ pass@1: delta > -5 points and exact McNemar p >= 0.05; RULER: <= 1 net item lost; answer agreement with the reference >= the accepted build's; thinking length ratio 0.90-1.10, 'Wait' rate ratio 0.85-1.15, no rise in truncations or loops
